description: The link the human opens to claim this project's free sandbox and keep its records, what claiming gives and how long an unclaimed sandbox has left. Show it to the user; do not open it yourself. Use this tool when the user only needs the claim link, or needs it again. signafaide_status shows the same link among the whole state of the project (key, chains, outbox, quota): call that one when you need those too. Read-only: with a sandbox key it asks the service whether the sandbox is still unclaimed; with no sandbox it makes no request and says so. It never creates a sandbox: that is signafaide_init, after the user agrees.

directory.description: Path of the project to work on: the folder the MCP server was started in, or one below it. Default: that folder.

name: signafaide_claim_link
title: signafAIde sandbox claim link
